persona: Real estate agents and property managers
desk: Rent roll — maintenance queue and owner approvals
title: Storm-damaged fence, Casuarina Court
prompt: Documentary photograph of a suburban Australian backyard the morning after a storm: a weathered grey timber paling fence with a run of palings knocked flat onto wet grass and one rail hanging loose, scattered gum leaves and small branches across the lawn, shallow puddles reflecting a grey sky that is clearing to soft light, a plain corrugated steel fence in the background. Wide eye-level framing, honest condition-report feel, no people.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
